courses.title: Monthly Rest Offering
courses.description: A yoga nidra recording to download and keep, with a short audio introduction and a different theme each month. It can be used before sleep or as a rest during the day.

left_out: An older product page with the same title (/rest-shop/p/monthly-rest-offering-1, a previous month's theme): same item, listed once.
flags: The page offers it to anyone finding it hard to fall or stay asleep: sleep wording, allowed under the new rule; no claim to treat insomnia as a condition.
